author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Jonny DeLuca hits dinger Saturday
desc: Jonny DeLuca went 2-for-5 with a home run, one run scored, two RBI and two stolen bases in Saturday's 10-8 loss against the Houston Astros.
impact: DeLuca turned in an impressive performance on Saturday, launching a 355-foot home run off Cristian Javier in the seventh inning while adding two stolen bases. He's been productive over his last seven games, slashing .238/.360/.429 with one home run, three runs scored, three RBI and two stolen bases.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Victor Mesa Jr. steals base Saturday
desc: Victor Mesa Jr. went 0-for-2 with two walks, one run scored and a stolen base in Saturday's 10-8 loss against the Houston Astros.
impact: While Mesa extended his hitless streak to three games, he still found a way to contribute by drawing two walks and scoring a run in the second inning. Despite seeing more consistent playing time, he remains off the fantasy radar, as he's slashing just .176/.279/.311 across 27 games this season.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Cedric Mullins II swipes bag Saturday
desc: Cedric Mullins II went 1-for-3 with two walks, one run scored and a stolen base in Saturday's 10-8 loss against the Houston Astros.
impact: Mullins has been one of the Tampa Bay Rays' hottest hitters of late, recording a hit in eight of his last nine games while collecting four home runs and two stolen bases during that span. He's becoming an increasingly appealing waiver wire option given his recent production, especially after batting third and fourth in the lineup in each of his last two starts.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Drew Rasmussen gives up two homers Saturday
desc: Drew Rasmussen allowed five runs on six hits and one walk while striking out two across five innings in Saturday's 10-8 loss against the Houston Astros.
impact: After posting a stellar 0.82 ERA and 0.61 WHIP across five starts in June, Rasmussen struggled in his first outing of July. He allowed five earned runs, matching his season high set May 30 against the Los Angeles Angels, and surrendered two home runs, tying another season high previously set April 18 against the Pittsburgh Pirates. Rasmussen will look to bounce back in his next scheduled start on Tuesday against the New York Yankees.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Adrian Del Castillo hits big home run Saturday
desc: Adrian Del Castillo went 1-for-3 with a home run and three RBI in the Diamondbacks 4-3 win over the Brewers on Saturday.
impact: Del Castillo opened the scoring in the first inning with a three-run blast off Brandon Woodruff. He is slashing just .185/.244/.311 on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Paul Sewald earns save Saturday
desc: Paul Sewald allowed one run over one inning in a save on Saturday against the Brewers.
impact: Sewald worked around a two out solo blast hit by Jackson Chourio. It was his 20th save on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Merrill Kelly earns win Saturday
desc: Merrill Kelly allowed two runs on eight hits over five innings with six strikeouts and two walks in a win on Saturday against the Brewers.
impact: Kelly allowed a two-run home run to Christian Yelich for the lone damage against him on the night. He'll carry a struggling 5.71 ERA into his next start against the Padres.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Griffin Canning takes loss Saturday
desc: Griffin Canning allowed one run on two hits over four innings with four strikeouts and two walks in a loss on Saturday against the Dodgers.
impact: Canning pitched behind Wandy Peralta, who opened the game with a scoreless inning. He pitched well in his four innings of work, but he isn't pitching long enough to hold high fantasy upside.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dominic Canzone goes deep Saturday
desc: Dominic Canzone went 2-for-4 with a home run and three RBI in the Mariners 11-0 win over the Blue Jays on Saturday.
impact: Canzone extended the Mariners lead to 7-0 with a two-run blast. He later added an RBI single. He is slashing .273/.349/.551 with 14 home runs on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cal Raleigh goes yard Saturday
desc: Cal Raleigh went 1-for-4 with a home run and three RBI in the Mariners 11-0 win over the Blue Jays on Thursday.
impact: Raleigh hit a three-run blast with Seattle already leading 8-0 at the time. It was just his ninth home run on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Randy Arozarena blasts grand slam Saturday
desc: Randy Arozarena went 3-for-4 with a home run and four RBI in the Mariners 11-0 win over the Blue Jays on Saturday.
impact: Shane Bieber recorded two quick outs in the second inning. Seattle had its next four hitters reach base before Arozarena broke the game open with a grand slam. It was his third career grand slam and he is up to nine long balls on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Logan Gilbert dominates into eighth inning Saturday
desc: Logan Gilbert allowed one hit over 7 1/3 innings with seven strikeouts in a win on Saturday against the Blue Jays.
impact: The lone hit (and baserunner) Gilbert allowed on the day came via a bloop single. To say he was dominant might be underselling the performance. He'll carry a 3.19 ERA into an outing against the Rays.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Konnor Griffin steals two bases Saturday
desc: Konnor Griffin went 1-for-5 with two steals in the Pirates 7-1 win over the Nationals on Saturday.
impact: Griffin opened the game stealing home in the first inning after he singled and stole second base. He is up to 19 steals on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Braxton Ashcraft earns win Saturday
desc: Braxton Ashcraft allowed one run on six hits over 5 2/3 innings with seven strikeouts and two walks in a win on Saturday against the Nationals.
impact: Ashcraft allowed an early home run to James Wood before he settled in for another dominant outing. He'll face the Brewers next ahead of the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brandon Woodruff (labrum) to be placed on IL
desc: Brewers manager Pat Murphy told reporters that Brandon Woodruff will be placed on the 15-day injured list with an inflamed right labrum.
impact: Woodruff suffered the same injury that sidelined him earlier in the season. He does not hold a timetable to return.
